sentences.text: This massive sauropod measured about 12 meters in length, stood 4 meters tall, and likely weighed around 10 tonnes.
It is distinguished from other sauropods by its mid-distal tail vertebrae, which feature opistocoelous centra—a specific type of curved joint surface.
Hailu, Qiang, Lamanna, Jinglu, and Yinxiang formally described the species in 2004.
Fossils were unearthed in the Sunjiawan Formation within Liaoning province, China.
Borealosaurus is placed within the family Saltasauridae.
The genus further belongs to the subfamily Opisthocoelicaudiinae.
The animal inhabited northern China during the Late Cretaceous period.
It lived approximately 89 to 84 million years ago, specifically during the Santonian stage.
Researchers Averianov and Sues debated the classification, considering Borealosaurus a non-lithostrotian titanosaur because of the lack of procoely in its middle caudal vertebrae.
